posts.cooked: Hey everyone. I am looking for a MMO to play and I cannot find any current good vidoes on Gameplay of EVE Online. As I was thinking WoW or EVE or ESO. Anyone know if it's worth to play this over them? or any links to recent videos

What kind of gameplay do you want? WoW and ESO are by-the-rails fantasy MMOs with pre-defined, packaged gameplay that's backed up by a well-developed system of pve content. EVE is an open-ended, full-loot pvp MMO in which most of the content comes from various forms of player interaction.

EVE has no p2w components at all. You can buy PLEXes and sell them to other players for ISK, but that's not equivalent for p2w since no advantage is generated for you out of thin air, since your monetary gain is another player's monetary loss.

If you want fantasy pve gameplay, then you should obviously play WoW or ESO instead of EVE.
